What We Do

Full-suite traffic control services

From the first sketch of a traffic control plan to the last cone off the road, JTS crews handle every part of the work zone so your project stays on schedule and everyone gets home safe.

Traffic Control Planning & Design

Site-specific plans built to OTM Book 7 standards before a single cone hits the road.

View details →

Flagging & Lane Closures

Certified traffic control persons on-site to open and close lanes safely for crews and equipment.

View details →

Pedestrian & Worker Safety

Dedicated watch for pedestrians, cyclists and crew, spotting hazards before they become incidents.

View details →

24/7 Emergency Response

Water main breaks don't wait for business hours. Neither do we. Crews are ready to deploy for utility emergencies day or night, including paid-duty coordination at intersections.

View details →

Equipment Rental

TC-12 arrow boards, signage, barricades and cones available to keep your site compliant.

Why JTS

Built by union tradespeople, trusted by major utilities.

2009Founded
Local 183Union Affiliated
6+Utility & Construction Partners
24/7On-Call Crews

JTS is a Local 183 union traffic control company that's been keeping Ontario work zones safe since 2009. We work alongside major utility and construction contractors, including Enbridge, TransPower, NPL, Brass Inc, NSG and Apex Fibre, supplying the crews and plans that keep their sites compliant and moving.

Every shift, we have someone on-site: opening lane closures for trucks, watching for pedestrians and hazards, and standing ready for emergency call-outs like water main breaks. When it matters, we work hand-in-hand with paid-duty officers and everyone else on the job to get it done right.

JTS is proud to be recognized among Canada's Safest Employers for 2025.

Where We Work

Serving the GTA, York Region & beyond

Based out of York Region, JTS crews deploy anywhere within about a four-hour radius of the GTA.

Toronto Mississauga Scarborough Vaughan Markham Richmond Hill Newmarket Keswick Barrie Oshawa Whitby Peterborough Hamilton Port Perry Wasaga Beach

Don't see your area? If it's within roughly four hours of the GTA, chances are we've already worked there. Get in touch and we'll confirm coverage for your site.

Need traffic control on-site?

Whether it's a scheduled shutdown or an emergency call-out, JTS crews are ready around the clock across the GTA and York Region.
